videos.title: Ranking NHL Team’s 2026-27 Prospect Pool | w/ Steven Ellis
videos.summary_source_text:
Ranking NHL Team’s 2026-27 Prospect Pool | w/ Steven Ellis Daily Faceoff prospect analyst Steven Ellis joins Daily Faceoff Live to break down his latest NHL prospect pool rankings, ranking all 32 organizations from top to bottom.

Steven explains why the Chicago Blackhawks sit at No. 1, how the Calgary Flames have made one of the biggest jumps in the rankings, and why the Nashville Predators have quietly built one of the deepest prospect groups in the NHL.

The guys also discuss whether Chicago could actually have too many young players competing for NHL opportunities, Calgary's need for a true high-end offensive star, and the potential of Ethan Wittenbach and the Flames' developing prospect group.

At the other end of the rankings, Steven explains why the Dallas Stars are 32nd despite having a strong NHL roster, and why he is actually more concerned about the Vegas Golden Knights' future than Dallas' when considering the age of their current roster and the strength of their prospect pool.

Plus, Steven discusses Trevor Connelly, Cameron Schmidt, goaltending prospects, Dustin Wolf, and the upcoming Daily Faceoff rankings for the top NHL goalies and skaters.

videos.summary_source_text:
I Finally Learnt How To Hit 3 Wood Consistently - Off The Deck AND Tee Want to know how to hit your 3 wood from the ground with better contact, more launch and more consistency? 

In this video, Mark Crossfield breaks down the simple 3 wood swing fundamentals that can help you strike your fairway woods properly from the deck.

Hitting a 3 wood off the ground is one of the hardest shots in golf, but many golfers make it even harder by treating their fairway wood like a driver. Ball position too far forward, hanging back through impact and trying to help the ball into the air can all lead to fat shots, topped shots and unwanted slices.

In this video you will learn how to improve your 3 wood fundamentals including ball position, setup and angle of attack, which will help you learn how to hit 3 wood off the ground like a pro.

You'll also learn why fairway wood loft matters. A 15-degree 3 wood isn't automatically the best choice for every golfer, and depending on your swing speed and delivery, a 4 wood, 5 wood or even 7 wood could give you better launch, carry and overall distance.

Stay to the end for a bonus tip on how to hit your 3 wood off the tee, including the correct tee height and why your expected shot shape may change compared with hitting the same club from the ground.

If you struggle to hit your 3 wood consistently, stop trying to make a driver swing and use these simple fairway wood tips to start producing better strikes.

videos.summary_source_text:
Chicken Tikka Masala #338 Hittade en YouTubekollega i Indien som heter Food Captain 🇮🇳

@food.captain_ 

RECEPT - Chicken Tikka Masala på stekhäll eller i inne i köket
Ingredienser
• 800 g kyckling. Bröst eller lårfilé 
• 2 gula lökar, tunt skivade 
• 1 chili, finhackad 
• 30 g färsk ingefära, finhackad eller riven 
• 4 vitlöksklyftor 
• 2 tsk chilipulver 
• 1½ tsk gurkmeja 
• 1½ msk garam masala 
• 2 tsk socker 
• 2 msk tomatpuré 
• 1 burk krossade tomater, 400 g 
• 2 dl vatten 
• 8–10 torkade curryblad 
• 2 dl turkisk eller grekisk yoghurt, 10 % 
• 1 kruka färsk koriander eller mynta
• 1½ tsk salt 
• Neutral olja till stekning 

Gör så här:
1. Stek två skivade lökar med hackad chili och ingefära
2. Pressa i vitlöken
3. Stek tills den är lätt brynt
4. Tillsätt chilipulver, gurkmeja, garam masala och socker
5. Rör i tomatpuré och en burk krossade tomater
6. Mixa i mixer
7. Stek kycklingen
8. Häll i den blandade kryddblandningen och tillsätt torra curryblad
9. Täck över och låt sjuda
10. Rör i yoghurt och hackad koriander el. mynta
11. NJUT

Mat’s got his hands on a Gunter Werks F-26, and it might be one of his favourite cars he’s reviewed in 2026! 

It’s based on a Porsche 911 993, but the similarities pretty much end at the use of the 993’s steel chassis! So what’s changed? Let’s take a closer look…

In terms of the design, the old steel panels have been removed and replaced with carbon fibre! Up front, there’s a load of carbon aero, including huge vents in the front bumper and a large scoop in the bonnet. Along the side, there are magnesium wheels and wider tyres, and the air intake at the rear wheel arches has been widened. Around the back there’s an absolutely massive wing, and the taillight design has been updated. All in all, it looks absolutely magnificent from the outside. 

And the story is similar inside! There’s carbon used throughout the interior, although some of the traditional functionality and features have been kept, such as the original dials. The cabin is well built, with a few smart features such as rope pull door handles and flashes of gold throughout, such as around the drive mode selector on the steering wheel. The seats are also super comfortable, and come in a two-tone design to help it stand out further. 

The 993’s original 3.6-litre naturally-aspirated flat-six has had a full reworking, and it’s now a 4-litre twin-turbo! It comes with three driving modes - Comfort mode with 550hp, Sport mode with 650hp, and Track mode with 850hp. All power is sent to the rear wheels only via a six-speed manual.

The most common type of vertigo is benign paroxysmal positional vertigo (BPPV), which is caused by displaced calcium crystals in the inner ear. This condition is especially common in women after menopause.

A protein called osteopontin helps keep calcium crystals tightly attached to the hairs of the inner ear. When this protein gets too high, these crystals can break off and become displaced, causing dizziness. Vitamin D plays a key role in regulating this protein.

Vitamin K2: take 100 mcg of MK7 Vitamin K2 for every 10,000 IU of vitamin D
Magnesium glycinate: take 400 mg daily

videos.title: Klassisk Originalburgare med Caj P.
videos.summary_source_text:
Klassisk Originalburgare med Caj P. Det finns ingenting som slår en riktigt bra burgare, och en somrig originalburgare är en klassiker av en anledning. Burgerdudes Originalburgare är både jättegod och lättlagad med Caj P. Hamburgerdressing, som har vunnit Burgerdudes stora blindtest av hamburgerdressing. Den passar perfekt med sin söta och lite syrliga smakbild. Den isade silverlöken ger extra mycket krisp i burgaren, medan salladen och tomaten bidrar med fräschör. Vi smashar köttet på en stekplatta på grillen, men det går lika bra att göra det på en gjutjärnspanna i köket.

Burgerdudes Originalburgare
4 portioner / 30 min

Ingredienser:
• 800 g grovmald högrevsfärs, 20–30 % fetthalt
• 4 hamburgerbröd, gärna briochebröd
• 8 skivor hamburgerost
• 1 silverlök
• Sallad
• Caj P. Hamburgerdressing
• Smör
• Salt och grovmald svartpeppar

Gör så här:
1. Dela upp färsen i 8 delar och forma löst till bollar med händerna.
2. Skiva silverlöken tunt och lägg den i en skål med kallt vatten och mycket is i minst 30 minuter. Låt rinna av i fem minuter innan användning.
3. Smält en liten klick smör i stekpannan eller stekplattan och rosta insidan av bröden. Lägg bröden åt sidan och torka av pannan eller plattan.
4. Höj värmen till maxvärme (cirka 250 grader). Lägg på köttbollarna och pressa med jämnt tryck till cirka 1 ½ cm tjocklek med ett smashverktyg cirka 10 sekunder. Salta och peppra generöst.
5. När små bubblor börjar bildas på köttets yta vänder du köttet med en vass stekspade. Lägg på 2 skivor hamburgerost per kött. Stek köttet ytterligare 1 minut. Låt köttet vila på en tallrik ett par minuter.
6. Bred ett jämnt lager Caj P. Hamburgerdressing på insidan av brödets botten, och lägg på sallad och ett lager av silverlök. Lägg två köttpuckar ovanpå. Bred ett jämnt lager Caj P. Hamburgerdressing på insidan av brödets lock och sätt sedan locket på köttet.
7. Njut av en riktigt god originalburgare. Det finns ingenting som slår en riktigt bra burgare, och en somrig originalburgare är en klassiker av en anledning. 26.08.26 - RIFT Training Day RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Hindi - 26.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Key Features

• Auto Trading Engine
• Manual Trading
• Futures Trading
• Non-Custodial Infrastructure

RIFT is built around a simple vision: making modern trading technology more accessible while helping users participate in financial markets through a combination of automation, education, and innovative infrastructure. RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

We identify consistency in your golf game as your bad shots being close enough to your good shots. If you can close the gap between your misses and your best shots, that’s true consistency!

videos.summary_source_text:
How To Coach Players Based On Anatomy The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: Så mycket har svensken på sitt ISK (2026)
videos.summary_source_text:
Så mycket har svensken på sitt ISK (2026) SEB har räknat fram siffror åt RikaTillsammans, baserat på data från Statistiska centralbyrån per december 2024, över hur mycket svenskar har sparat på sina ISK-konton.

Mediansvensken hade vid det tillfället cirka 90 000 kr sparat. Eftersom det bara är fyra miljoner svenskar som har ett ISK alls, betyder det att den som ligger över medianen faktiskt ligger över en stor del av hela den svenska befolkningen.

För att tillhöra topp 25 % av ISK-ägarna krävdes 318 000 kr, och för topp 10 % rikaste krävdes 951 000 kr.

Jan påpekar att skillnader i sparat belopp ofta hänger ihop med ålder och var man är i sin ekonomiska resa, snarare än med hur bra eller dåligt man sköter sin ekonomi.

Fullständig genomgång i avsnittet "Hur rik är svensken?" på rikatillsammans.se som släpps närmsta veckorna.

videos.summary_source_text:
Gemini 3.7 Flash: You're Only Using 20% of Its Prompting Power https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Most people are barely scratching the surface of Gemini 3.7 Flash.

And the missing piece isn’t a secret prompt, a magic phrase, or telling the AI to “think harder.”

In this video, I break down how to actually use Gemini 3.7 Flash based on Google’s documentation — including better prompting, reasoning controls, long-context workflows, grounding, coding, screenshot analysis, tool use, prompt chaining, and a much better alternative to asking AI, “Are you sure?”

You’ll learn how to turn vague requests into structured tasks that Gemini can actually execute, why giant mega-prompts often make things worse, how to use evidence instead of relying on model memory, and how to audit AI-generated answers using observable checks.

We’ll also look at how these ideas apply to real workflows: coding tasks, analyzing screenshots, research, reasoning, validation, and working with large amounts of context.

⏱️ CHAPTERS

00:00 Introduction
01:19 What This Model Actually Is, In Under Two Minutes
03:17 The Habit That's Quietly Wasting Half Your Prompts
04:35 The Framework That Actually Fixes It
07:16 Turning It Into a Coding Partner, Not a Guesser
09:18 Reading a Screenshot Like an Engineer, Not a Viewer
10:39 Reasoning Is Now a Dial, Not a Magic Phrase
12:10 Stop Asking "Are You Sure"
13:20 A Few More Habits Worth Retiring
14:14 The Actual Template Worth Saving
15:08 The Verdict

The framework is simple:

Goal → Context → Boundaries → Evidence → Output → Validation

You don’t need every element in every prompt. The point is to give the model the information that actually changes the answer — and remove as much unnecessary guessing as possible.

If you use Gemini for coding, research, writing, analysis, or everyday work, try the framework on one prompt you use constantly and compare the result.

Let me know in the comments what changed.

videos.title: 1 000 HK + MANUELL! I Italienska Kimera – Budget-Koenigsegg?!
videos.summary_source_text:
1 000 HK + MANUELL! I Italienska Kimera – Budget-Koenigsegg?! Jag var på The Aurora i Båstad och tittade närmare på ett av bilvärldens mest fascinerande – och oväntade – samarbeten. 
Ronnie Gustafsson har slagit till och beställt ett av endast tio exemplar av den absolut mest exklusiva Kimera K39-modellen som ska byggas. Det är en hyperbil som blandar rå italiensk racingnostalgi med svensk hyperbilsteknik.

Projektet tog fart när Kimeras vd och grundare, Luca Betti, introducerades för Christian von Koenigsegg. Personkemin fanns där direkt, och de började snabbt drömma om ett gemensamt mål: att erövra den legendariska backtävlingen Pikes Peak.
Resultatet är Kimera K39, vars design lånar tungt från Lancias racinghistoria, specifikt Beta Montecarlo Turbo och det glada Grupp B-talet. Men det riktigt intressanta – och det som skaver på ett positivt sätt – hittar vi under huven.

Koenigsegg har tagit fram en skräddarsydd 5,0-liters V8 med dubbelturbo exklusivt för bilen. Motorn bygger på Jesko-arkitekturen, men Kimera och Koenigsegg har medvetet valt att avstå från den extrema toppeffekten (som i Jesko ligger på cirka 1 600 hk på E85). I stället har motorn bestyckats med mindre turboaggregat från Agera-serien. Syftet är att prioritera en blixtsnabb gasrespons framför enorma siffror på ett papper.
Trots att K39 drivs på helt vanlig 95-oktanig pumpbensin levererar den hela 1 000 hk och 1 200 Nm. Som en sista motvikt till dagens digitaliserade fartvidunder skickas all kraft till bakhjulen via en 7-växlad manuell låda. Ett djärvt val för en bil som ska tävla i Pikes Peak.

Se till att prenumerera så du inte missar något!

Så idag tänkte jag sätta mig ner med Pappa Poon… och prata om livet på riktigt. 
Tack Pappa! Älskar dig! 

Gör det du med! 
Här är frågorna:

1. Hur var de första dagarna när du blev pappa?
2. Vad har kärlek lärt dig genom livet?
3. Varför tror du att vi har en sån bra relation, vad är hemligheten
4. Tror du att vi säger ‘jag älskar dig’ till varandra tillräckligt mycket
5. Vad är ditt favorit minne med oss i familjen?
6. Vilken tid har varit din bästa tid, 20 års åldern-30,40 50?
7. Vad skulle du säga är dina bästa och sämsta egenskaper?
8. När kände du dig som mest stolt över mig?
9. Vad önskar du mest för dina barn?
10. Vad är det finaste jag gjort för dig?
11. Vad är något jag( Filip)  hade kunnat göra för att vara en bättre son?
12. Vad är något du önskar att du hade gjort annorlunda som pappa?

15. Vad tror du att jag inte förstår om dig idag?
16. Vad har varit den svåraste perioden i ditt liv?
17. Har du någonsin känt dig ensam, även runt andra människor?
18. Vad drömde du om när du var ung, vad ville du bli?

20. Vad betyder framgång för dig idag?
21. Vad är du mest tacksam över i livet?

videos.title: Joe Milton III Opens Up About His HUGE Year 2 Jump With the Cowboys
videos.summary_source_text:
Joe Milton III Opens Up About His HUGE Year 2 Jump With the Cowboys Joe Milton III joins the media after his impressive preseason performance and opens up about his development heading into Year 2 with the Cowboys.

Milton explains why he feels he has made a huge jump in the Cowboys' offensive system, including his understanding of the offense, his ability to use his progressions and safety valves, and his improved mechanics and accuracy.

He also discusses the quarterback competition, why he loves competing, and the biggest mental adjustment he made this offseason: learning how to flush mistakes and move on to the next play.

Milton opens up about how becoming a father to a daughter has helped him develop more patience and changed the way he handles mistakes and adversity.

Plus, he talks about Cowboys receivers Jonathan Mingo and Camden Brown, their work ethic and their competition for a roster spot, as well as his relationship with rookie safety Caleb Downs. videos.title: How to Trust Your Body Again
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Trust Your Body Again Trusting your body does not mean pretending that everything feels fine.

It does not mean ignoring pain, forcing positive thoughts, or pushing yourself through every uncomfortable experience.

Body trust grows through experience.

Small moments when:

You move without bracing as much.
Your body surprises you.
You feel supported.
You discover another option.
Movement feels a little easier or more possible.

One student in my course realized that a part of her body had not necessarily changed—but her relationship with it had. She no longer experienced it as an isolated mechanical part that constantly needed to be fixed. She could sense herself as a whole person again.

That relational change is at the heart of body trust.

In this video, I guide you through a short somatic reflection that includes what feels difficult without allowing the difficult part to become your entire body story.

This is the final video in my From Protection to Possibility series.

If you are ready to stop figuring this out alone and would like support rebuilding ease, connection, and trust through guided somatic movement, schedule a Discovery & Alignment Call:

https://calendly.com/taroiwamoto/45min
We’ll explore what you want to change and honestly determine whether my 8-week guided journey, Moving Freely in Your Body, is the right fit.

https://taroiwamoto.com/thecourse

This course is for thoughtful, self-aware adults who are ready to move beyond chasing relief, correcting their body, or piecing together random exercises — and begin learning a different relationship with their body through guided somatic movement.

The 8 Early WARNING Signs of Pancreatic Cancer These subtle symptoms can be early warning signs of pancreatic cancer, and they’re easy to miss. Pancreatic cancer often causes very few symptoms early on, which makes paying attention to sudden or unexplained changes especially important.

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4x8dMUv

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements. 

Watch for:
• Unexplained weight loss
• Severe bloating, gas, or greasy or floating stool
• New onset of diabetes or suddenly worsening blood sugar
• Upper abdominal discomfort that wraps around to the back
• Loss of appetite or feeling full after a few bites
• Chronic fatigue that doesn’t improve with sleep
• Yellowing of the skin or eyes
• Dark urine or light-colored stool

If you notice persistent or unexplained changes like these, get them checked so a potential problem can be caught as early as possible.

25.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.summary_source_text:
Point Projection Over / Under. Say Nice Things About: Carolina Hurricanes. Colorado Avalanche’s star power faces the ultimate over-under test: will Nathan MacKinnon, Martin Nečas, and Cale Makar surpass their projected point totals in a high-stakes 84-game NHL season? Chris Micieli and Zach Pearson break down The Hockey News’ bold predictions for the Avs’ top players, debating whether MacKinnon can eclipse 133 points, Nečas’ continued breakout, and Makar’s Norris Trophy potential. The hosts assess expectations for Artturi Lehkonen, Brock Nelson, and Nazem Kadri, while considering how lineup spots and health could shape each Avalanche player’s offensive ceiling.

The conversation shifts as the duo say some “nice things” about the Carolina Hurricanes, the Stanley Cup champs, highlighting their likable roster, Rod Brind’Amour’s coaching, and Shane Gostisbehere’s impact. Plus, who’s the perfect Disney character to represent the Avalanche? Don’t miss this stats-driven, fun, and fan-fueled episode that puts Colorado’s top talent under the microscope ahead of a championship chase.

videos.title: Jaishawn Barham BREAKS His Silence After HUGE Cowboys Debut
videos.summary_source_text:
Jaishawn Barham BREAKS His Silence After HUGE Cowboys Debut Cowboys rookie linebacker Jaishawn Barham meets with the media after making his preseason debut and discusses his development, earning the trust of his coaches and teammates, and adjusting to the NFL.

Barham talks about the responsibility of calling plays and directing the defense as a rookie, along with how he's adjusted after missing time with an injury. He also explains what he still needs to improve, including his hands, playing lower, sideline-to-sideline ability and coverage.

Barham also breaks down some of the plays he made against Arizona, including his ability to slip blocks, and discusses what he needs to do to be ready for Week 1.

Plus, the Cowboys rookie talks about his relationship with Christian Parker and Scott Simon and why asking questions has been such an important part of his development. videos.title: From Franchisee to CEO: Building the Future of Indoor Golf | Closed Course w/ Michael Ruvolo
videos.summary_source_text:
From Franchisee to CEO: Building the Future of Indoor Golf | Closed Course w/ Michael Ruvolo Welcome back to another episode of ‘Closed Course’!

The guys are back with another great guest interview, this time joined by Michael Ruvolo, President and CEO of X-Golf America, one of the fastest-growing indoor golf and entertainment brands in the country.

Michael’s journey with X-Golf started from the ground up. After opening his first location in 2019, he continued expanding through COVID, eventually growing to five locations before being offered the opportunity to take over the entire company in 2024. Today, X-Golf has grown to more than 130 locations across the country, combining golf, technology, entertainment, food and drinks into a unique experience for golfers of every skill level.

Michael and the hosts dive into what makes X-Golf different from other indoor golf experiences, including its proprietary simulator technology, automatic ball-feeding system and focus on creating a faster, more realistic experience. They also discuss how indoor golf has continued to grow, why X-Golf works in both cold and warm-weather markets, and where Michael sees the company heading next.

The conversation goes beyond the simulators as Michael shares what he’s learned building and scaling a business. From pouring beers and cooking food at his own locations to now leading the entire X-Golf organization, Michael talks about the work it takes to turn an idea into a successful business and why empowering the people around you is so important.

Of course, it wouldn’t be ‘Closed Course’ without plenty of golf talk. Michael shares his dream foursome, stories about following Jon Rahm and J.J. Spaun before they became household names, his love for the game and what makes simulator golf so competitive and accessible.

The guys also get Michael’s side of the viral Pat McAfee X-Golf simulator story. Michael explains how the simulator ended up on McAfee’s set, what actually happened when it failed to register a shot, and why the simulator itself wasn’t broken.

Tune into the latest episode of ‘Closed Course’ for a conversation about golf, entrepreneurship, the rise of indoor golf and what’s next for X-Golf America.

videos.title: The Rare Secret Of Skating Rotation
videos.summary_source_text:
The Rare Secret Of Skating Rotation The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: Use Your Lead Leg for More Speed
videos.summary_source_text:
Use Your Lead Leg for More Speed If you tend to miss golf shots short and right, pay attention to your lead leg... 👀⛳️

A lot of golfers think creating more rotation means they need to twist harder with their upper body.

But this video shows a different way to think about it.

Good golf swing rotation starts with how you use the ground.

Load into the trail side, shift pressure toward the lead side, then use that lead leg to push up and rotate through the golf ball.

Think:
LOAD RIGHT → SHIFT LEFT → PUSH THROUGH

Instead of trying to create all your speed by twisting with your upper body, you’re using your legs and pressure shift to help generate the rotation.

That can give you a much better foundation for clubhead speed, power, and more consistent ball striking.

Watch the video again and focus on the left leg. Notice how getting pressure onto that side creates a place to push from through the shot.

The hard part is actually learning what that pressure shift is supposed to feel like in your own golf swing.

That’s where the Ball First Board comes in.

It gives you physical feedback while you practice so you can train the load, shift, and push instead of wondering whether you’re doing it correctly.

If you’ve been trying to create more speed by simply swinging or twisting harder, start from the ground up.

videos.title: Hälften av svenskar 🇸🇪 har under 2 000 kr kvar före lön (2026)
videos.summary_source_text:
Hälften av svenskar 🇸🇪 har under 2 000 kr kvar före lön (2026) En undersökning från Infostat, genomförd på tusen personer och statistiskt säkerställt för Sverige, visar att hälften av svenskarna har under 2 000 kr kvar på kontot dagen innan lön. 2,5 % har mindre än ingenting, och 15 % har i stort sett inget kvar.

SCB:s data förstärker bilden ytterligare: 23 % av befolkningen skulle inte klara en oplanerad utgift på 14 000 kr.

Jan reflekterar över att detta ofta blir en viktig reality check för den som har en god ekonomi som följer en — alla har det inte likadär, och det är värt att hålla i minnet när man pratar om ekonomisk trygghet.

Mer om vad svensken sparar på rikatillsammans.se.

videos.title: How to Stickhandle Faster
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Stickhandle Faster Welcome to Precise Puck Control.

There’s a reason we call this puck control and not just stickhandling.

Stickhandling usually refers to isolated mechanics like moving the puck around cones or in drills disconnected and from real gameplay. Puck control, in our context, is different. It’s the conscious ability to move the puck exactly where you want, at the speed you want, while your skating, shooting, and deception mechanics are fully integrated.

At Train 2.0, we teach it as part of a complete movement system.

The truth: isolated stickhandling doesn’t transfer to games. You might develop quick hands. You might look smooth in drills. But without integrating footwork, balance, posture, and skating mechanics, you’ll be missing that puck on a string look in-game.

We’ve all seen players with “great hands” who somehow struggle in games. That disconnect happens when puck skills are trained without mechanical awareness or integration. Repeating the same patterns around cones without adjusting mechanics can actually reinforce bad habits instead of building elite control.

Our goal with this system is to give you a language for puck control: a mechanical framework you can understand, feel, and adjust. When you combine awareness with deliberate repetition, you build mastery.

Inside this course, you’ll learn:

1) How elite NHL players integrate skating, handling, and deception.

2) What mechanical adjustments create real control at top speed.

3) How to systematically close the gaps in your own puck control.

4) How to create more options in more situations during games.

videos.summary_source_text:
Gemini 4 Explained: Google’s 2 Trillion Parameter AI https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Google’s Gemini 4 could become one of the most important AI models of 2026 — but how much of what we’re hearing about it is actually true?

In this video, we investigate the story behind Gemini 4, the delayed Gemini 3.5 Pro, Google’s reported struggles with coding and agentic coding, and the viral claim that Gemini 4 could have 2 trillion parameters.

Google originally said Gemini 3.5 Pro was coming in June. That deadline passed, and reports from Bloomberg and Reuters later pointed to concerns around coding performance and competition from OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI labs. Sundar Pichai subsequently acknowledged areas where Gemini needed to improve, including coding and agentic coding, while describing Gemini 4 as a larger base model Google needs to compete at the AI frontier.

But is Gemini 4 really a 2 trillion parameter AI model? And was it accelerated because Gemini 3.5 Pro failed to meet expectations?

We separate what Google has actually confirmed from rumors and speculation, examine the competitive pressure surrounding Gemini, and break down what Gemini 4 could mean for the next stage of the AI race.

videos.title: Golf Swing Too Steep? Try This Wall Drill
videos.summary_source_text:
Golf Swing Too Steep? Try This Wall Drill If your golf swing is too steep, this wall drill can help you understand what needs to change. ⛳️

A lot of golfers try to fix a steep downswing by forcing the club to shallow on the way down.

But the problem can start much earlier.

Watch what happens in this drill.

If the club works too steep, the wall gives you immediate feedback. Instead, work on allowing the club, wrists, and elbows to move more behind you as your body turns into the backswing.

From there, you have a much better opportunity to rotate through and get the club working from the inside instead of coming down steep.

That’s what makes this drill so useful.

You’re not staring at a swing video trying to decide if your golf swing plane looks right.

You have a physical boundary that tells you right away.

Too steep? You know it.
Better path? You feel it.

And that same idea is why I like practicing with the Blue Brick.

The Blue Brick uses alignment sticks as a physical reference for your swing, giving you feedback while you’re actually making the movement.

So instead of telling yourself:
“Shallow the club.”
“Swing from the inside.”
“Stop coming over the top.”

You have something in front of you that helps you train the path.
If this wall drill makes sense to you, the Blue Brick gives you a way to bring that type of feedback to your practice sessions.

👇 See how the Blue Brick works or Comment "BRICK" for the link:
https://improve.shotcraftgolf.com/products/blue-brick/lp9_big_swing?utm_content=youtube-short-WalldrillSteep&utm_medium=social

Watch the reel again and pay attention to where the club is at the top, then where it starts working as the body rotates.

Save this one for your next range session!

videos.summary_source_text:
I DRAG RACED the World’s COOLEST toy cars! This would be the most expensive Carwow drag race of all time… If they were full-sized! 

Explore new and used car deals on Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-25-08

We’ve got our hands on a Porsche Speedster, a Ferrari 250 GT, a Series 1 Jaguar E-Type, and a Mercedes 300SL - but with a difference! 

Junior Cars lent us all four cars, and they’re miniature replicas of these world-famous sports cars! 

Each of the four cars comes with a steel chassis and fibreglass bodywork that replicates the original car. videos.title: 479. Hur mycket sparar svensken 2026? | Jämför ditt månadssparande

479. Hur mycket sparar svensken 2026? | Jämför ditt månadssparande • • Vad sparar svensken egentligen, och hur ligger du till jämfört med snittet? Den officiella sparkvoten på 13,5 % låter bra, men den räknar in tjänste- och premiepensionen. Ditt eget, fria sparande är troligen närmare 5,9 % av din disponibla inkomst, cirka 2 000 kronor i månaden.

I det här avsnittet går vi igenom siffror från SCB, SEB, SBAB, Nordea, Avanza och Lysa, plus nästan 10 000 svar från RikaTillsammans-communityn, där medianen ligger på 8 100 kronor i månaden, nästan fyra gånger snittet. Vi tittar också på spargapet mellan män och kvinnor, som räknat över tid kan handla om miljoner kronor, och landar i att ett sparande faktiskt är en uppoffring du gärna får ge dig själv en klapp på axeln för.

Några av ämnena vi tar upp i veckans avsnitt är:

• Sparkvoten på 13,5 % är en synvilla – det egna sparandet ligger på 5,9 %
• Vad svensken faktiskt sparar till: pension, buffert och bostad
• Så mycket sparar folk enligt SCB, SEB, SBAB, Nordea och Avanza
• Spargapet: män sparar 28 % mer än kvinnor i månaden

videos.summary_source_text:
24.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

• AI-Powered Trading Tools
• Copy Trading Features

videos.summary_source_text:
Tingling or Numb Feet? You May Be Missing This Benfotiamine is a fat-soluble form of vitamin B1 that is especially useful for nerve health and problems related to high blood sugar. Vitamin B1 is needed by enzymes in the mitochondria that help your cells produce energy. The more glucose you have circulating in the blood, the more vitamin B1 your body requires.

🌟 Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4hINjIs

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements. 

Benfotiamine can be especially helpful for:
• Tingling, numbness, or burning in the feet and hands
• Decreasing peripheral neuropathy
• Supporting healthy nerve function
• Reducing the formation of advanced glycation end products (AGEs)
• Protecting proteins and mitochondria from glycation damage

High blood sugar can increase glycation and contribute to many of the complications associated with diabetes. Benfotiamine helps slow that process while supporting healthy vitamin B1 levels and nerve function.

Try This Simple Mix | Dr. Mandell Plaque buildup, surface stains, unwanted bacteria, and yellowing can make your teeth look and feel less clean, but a simple combination of coconut oil and baking soda may be a useful addition to your oral-care routine. In this video, I’ll show you how these two common ingredients work together, how coconut oil and its lauric acid may help reduce certain oral bacteria, and how baking soda can gently help remove surface stains and neutralize acids in the mouth. You’ll learn exactly how to prepare this simple mixture, how to brush with it gently without overdoing the abrasion, how often to use it, and why coconut oil is also commonly used for oil pulling. I’ll also explain why you should never swallow the oil and why it’s better to dispose of it in the trash rather than the sink. Remember, this is intended to complement regular brushing, flossing, fluoride toothpaste, and professional dental care—not replace them. If plaque has hardened into tartar or calculus, it generally requires professional removal by a dentist or dental hygienist. Try these oral-care tips responsibly and share this video with someone who wants cleaner-looking, brighter teeth and healthier gums.

videos.title: 5 Bodyweight Exercises That Fix 95% Of Your Problems
videos.summary_source_text:
5 Bodyweight Exercises That Fix 95% Of Your Problems 22 Days to More Pullups - https://athleanx.com/morepullups
Subscribe to this channel here - http://bit.ly/2b0coMW

If you are looking for 5 exercises that fix 95% of your problems, then you’ve come to the right place. In this video, I am going to show you 5 different exercises that will help to deal with the common problem areas in the body as well as working on those stiff and achey joints so you can feel loose and pain free throughout the day.

The first exercise up a pushup variation done to target very specific problem areas. If you have bad posture, rounded, tight, achey shoulders and low back problems, this hand-release superman pushup will address those areas immediately. By extending the arms straight out in front, you are promoting overhead shoulder biomechanics and thoracic extension. When it comes to bad posture, we often have trouble getting our arms overhead, especially due to rounding of the thoracic spine. If we can get thoracic extension, we can promote good posture. It's important to note that we often neglect the muscles on the backside of our body, which leads to weakness which then leads to poor posture and biomechanics. 

When it comes to addressing the lower back, we often have a weakness in the lumbar spine area. We focus most of our efforts on building size and strength of the lats, but the muscles of the lower back, when weak, can become painful. By lifting our legs off the ground in this superman pushup, we are directly strengthening the muscles of the low back.

The second exercise that will fix 95% of your body's problems is a combination between one of my favorite mobility exercises and one of my favorite ab exercises. The bridge and reach over will again promote thoracic mobility, helping to alleviate some of the postural problems you may have. On top of that, though, this part of the combo will also help to strengthen the glutes. Weak glutes often contributes to dysfunction like anterior pelvic tilt and low back pain. Therefore, if we can strengthen the glutes while working on the posture of our upper body, we will be setting ourselves up for postural success and a life without chronic pain.

The second half of this combo features the heels to the heaven exercise or swiper. Swiping your hands underneath your low back while you perform this exercise will give immediate feedback that you are doing the movement correctly. If you can't swipe your hands underneath, you are not getting your pelvis off the ground. This means that you are likely using your hip flexors instead of your lower abs to initiate the movement.

The third exercise that you should be doing in an effort to fix 95% of your problems is another combination that mashes up a bodyweight squat and static reverse creeping lunge. Here we will again address thoracic extension as you will need to stay as upright as possible during the entire movement. This can be reinforced by folding your hands and holding them against your sternum - your knuckles should be facing the ceiling at all times. Squat down and pause, from here, step back one leg into a reverse lunge, return and step back the other leg.

This combo is extremely effective at targeting hip stability because of the unilateral nature of the lunge portion of the exercise. Stronger hips will lead to better balance as well as preventing back pain. Most sources of low back pain don't come from your back directly, but weakness in the muscles of the hips like the glute medius.

The next exercise is a home variation on one of my favorite exercises that I find to be extremely beneficial when it comes to training the upper body and correcting any deficiencies we may have. The doorway facepull. Simply press against the door frame with the back of your hands and pull your upper body forward until you feel the muscles in your upper back and rear delts engaging.

This exercise will strengthen the muscles of the upper back that often get neglected, along with the rear delts and the rotator cuff (thanks to the external rotation present within the exercises form itself). This might be one of the most effective exercises for correcting posture and promoting shoulder health and there is a reason that I continue to program the gym and home version of this exercise whenever I can.

Be sure to watch the video to the very end to see the final exercise that will help fix 95% of your problems.

If you are looking for a complete workout routine and meal plan to compliment your flexibility and mobility routine, be sure to head to athleanx.com and check out the program selector tool. It will take you just minutes to find the exact plan that fits your current goals and will help you to build ripped athletic muscle quickly.

videos.title: The REAL Difference Between A Pro And A 10 Handicap
videos.summary_source_text:
The REAL Difference Between A Pro And A 10 Handicap Where do amateur golfers actually lose the shots that stop them shooting lower scores? In this pro vs amateur golf match, Mark Crossfield plays against a 10 handicapper (with a twist) to find out how the best golfers lower their scores and where higher handicap golfers really lose shots.

In this golf match, we're testing driving vs approach play in a completely different way.

Mark and a 10 handicap golfer play a match, but after every tee shot, they swap balls. Mark has to finish each hole from the amateur golfer's drive, while the 10 handicapper gets to play from Mark's tee shot.

Can playing from a pro's tee shots help an amateur golfer shoot lower scores, and will Mark be able to recover from having to play a 10 handicapper's drives?

The result might surprise you.

This experiment provides a fascinating look at strokes gained golf, golf course management, penalty shots off the tee and where golfers really gain and lose shots during a round.

While amateur golfers can lose huge chunks of their score through penalty shots and costly mistakes, better players are constantly making smaller gains across every area of their game: approach play, short game, putting, decision-making and avoiding unnecessary penalty shots.

It's a great example of why Mark Broadie's Every Shot Counts is such a useful way of understanding golf strokes gained — small advantages across every part of the game quickly add up.

If you're trying to understand how to lower your golf scores, improve your golf course management or simply work out where you're really losing shots, this match gives you a practical look at how strokes gained plays out on the golf course rather than just on a spreadsheet.

Watch the match, see who comes out on top, and let us know in the comments: if you could have a pro golfer hit one type of shot for you all round, which would you choose?

videos.summary_source_text:
The Win He Waited 14 Years For | 2026 Nexo Championship Relive the final round action in the Back 9 on Sunday, presented by Nexo, as Scott Jamieson ended a near 14-year wait for his second DP World Tour title at the Nexo Championship.

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

The closing swing returns to where it started, Scotland. The winner of the closing swing will earn a spot in all Back 9 tournaments and receive a bonus. After a successful inaugural year under Nexo’s title sponsorship, the championship returns to the Old Course at Trump International Golf Links. In windy conditions, the true challenge of links golf is at its most apparent and that is expected to be the case again this week, so every opportunity needs to be capitalised on. After this week, there are just 11 events scheduled to take place before the Race to Dubai champion is crowned. Patrick Reed who is teeing it up this weekend is currently in line to take the crown for the first time. Also teeing it up this weekend chasing Patrick Reed in the Race to Dubai rankings is Eugenio Chacarra and Casey Jarvis, along with John Daly II, who is making his professional debut on the DP World Tour. For the first time this year there will be a Celebrity Pro-Am featuring some of the biggest Scottish sporting stars from Tennis, Rugby and Football such as Andy Murray, Kyle Steyn and James McArthur.

This AI Creates Insane 3D Worlds This might be one of the coolest AI models I’ve seen all year.

Tencent’s new WorldClaw model can generate an entire editable 3D world from a prompt — not just the environment, but every individual object inside it.

Trees, buildings, carts, lamp posts, terrain, they’re all generated as separate 3D assets you can actually work with.

Under the hood, it combines image generation, segmentation, and Tencent’s Hunyuan 2D-to-3D tech to turn a generated scene into a full collection of 3D objects.

And the use cases could get really interesting.

You could imagine generating game environments in minutes, building virtual worlds for simulations, or even creating environments where robots can train before they ever enter the real world.

Unfortunately we can’t actually play with this model yet, but this is absolutely one I’m keeping an eye on.

videos.title: 'The Fight Is Still On!' Dutch GP Review | F1 Nation Podcast
videos.summary_source_text:
'The Fight Is Still On!' Dutch GP Review | F1 Nation Podcast Tom Clarkson is in the Zandvoort paddock with F1 correspondent Lawrence Barretto and F1TV expert Alex Brundle for reaction to a chaotic Dutch Grand Prix. 

Back-to-back wins for Lando Norris means he’s now 83 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli with 11 races to go, so is the McLaren driver back in the title fight? 

Despite being behind him for most of the weekend, Kimi Antonelli got the better of his Mercedes teammate George Russell on race day. Why didn’t George have the pace when it really mattered? Were Mercedes right to issue team orders to get George out of Kimi’s way in the closing stages? 

On the topic of team orders, Lewis Hamilton was very frustrated that Ferrari didn’t ask Charles Leclerc to let him past. Did that cost Hamilton a podium? And what does his fiery team radio and post-race reaction tell us about the seven-time World Champion’s mindset? 

Plus, the guys discuss home race heartbreak for Max Verstappen after he crashed out on lap one, the impact Fernando Alonso’s second points finish of the season will have on his future with Aston Martin, and a dramatic end to the weekend for Williams as Carlos Sainz crashed into teammate Alex Albon.

videos.title: New Audi RS5: has Audi ruined it?
videos.summary_source_text:
New Audi RS5: has Audi ruined it? The all-new Audi RS5 has one BIG secret - and it might not be a good thing!

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Audi RS5! 

While it’s clear to see that this new generation RS has had a makeover from the outside, it’s hiding a secret that you can’t see from the design alone. It’s now a plug-in hybrid, and as a result, the weight has shot up to over 2,300kg! 

In comparison, the BMW M3 that we’ve brought along for this review tips the scales at only 1,790kg - so the RS5 is more than half a tonne heavier! The question is, does the weight really make such a big difference? Let’s take a closer look. 

Even if you’re not a fan of hybrid tech, there’s no denying that the new RS5 looks seriously impressive! Up from there’s a huge, aggressive-looking wide grille, and a whole load of vents that all serve a purpose. Along the side the widened wheel arches give the car more presence on the road, as do the side skirts. Along the back, the design is relatively similar to the standard A5, although there’s a small boot lip spoiler, coupled with a new lower bumper with a big diffuser and two massive exhausts. 

On the inside, the layout is relatively similar to the standard A5 & S5, although there are a few differences. There’s an octagonal sports steering wheel, which comes with both ‘RS’ and ‘Boost’ buttons to easily configure the driving mode. There are RS sports seats with red stitching, RS badging on the kick plates, and Alcantara-type material across the dash. The digital dial screen also comes with bespoke RS dials. Otherwise, the layout is pretty much the same as the standard car, with a large curved dial & infotainment screen, as well as a screen for the passenger.

The new Audi RS5 is powered by a 2.9-litre twin-turbo V6, coupled with an electric motor. Combined, the new RS5 puts down 639hp and 825Nm. This power is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic gearbox. 

The new Audi RS5 costs from £89,400, which is around £2,000 less than a BMW M3, which is a couple of years older. What’s more, the cost of the RS5 we’re reviewing, with added options, is around £97,000, while the M3 is loaded with kit and costs approximately £118,000! But is the non-hybrid M3 a better option than the surprisingly heavy RS5? Join Mat for this all-new review, and then let us know which you’d choose in the comments!

videos.title: Your Golf Swing Starts From the Ground Up
videos.summary_source_text:
Your Golf Swing Starts From the Ground Up If you’re struggling with inconsistent ball striking, chunks, thin shots, or a golf swing that feels all arms, look down before you start changing what your hands are doing. 👀⛳️

Your pressure shift might be the missing piece.
Watch the feet and hips closely in this video, because the important part isn’t just where your weight goes, it’s when it gets there.

In the backswing, pressure loads into the trail side, staying more toward the inside of the trail foot rather than drifting to the outside.

But here’s the part a lot of golfers miss:
You don’t wait until the backswing is finished to start moving toward the target.
As the club is finishing the backswing, pressure is already beginning to move toward the lead side.

That gives you a better opportunity to rotate through the shot instead of:
→ Hanging back on your trail foot
→ Sliding through impact
→ Throwing the arms at the ball
→ Trying to save the strike at the last second

Think of the sequence as:
LOAD → SHIFT → ROTATE

Not:
LOAD → WAIT → PANIC. 😅

And this is why simply watching weight-shift videos can only get you so far.
You may understand exactly what you’re supposed to do and still have no idea whether you’re actually doing it.

That’s the problem the Ball First Board is designed to solve.

It gives you physical feedback for the trail-side load, helps prevent excessive sway, and gives you a reference for moving into the lead side so you can train the movement you’re seeing in this video instead of guessing.

If you’re tired of knowing what a good golf swing should look like but struggling to reproduce the feeling, this is where I’d start.

videos.title: The Untaught Stickhandling Mechanics You Need To Know
videos.summary_source_text:
The Untaught Stickhandling Mechanics You Need To Know Welcome to Precise Puck Control.

There’s a reason we call this puck control and not just stickhandling.

Stickhandling usually refers to isolated mechanics like moving the puck around cones or in drills disconnected and from real gameplay. Puck control, in our context, is different. It’s the conscious ability to move the puck exactly where you want, at the speed you want, while your skating, shooting, and deception mechanics are fully integrated.

At Train 2.0, we teach it as part of a complete movement system.

The truth: isolated stickhandling doesn’t transfer to games. You might develop quick hands. You might look smooth in drills. But without integrating footwork, balance, posture, and skating mechanics, you’ll be missing that puck on a string look in-game.

We’ve all seen players with “great hands” who somehow struggle in games. That disconnect happens when puck skills are trained without mechanical awareness or integration. Repeating the same patterns around cones without adjusting mechanics can actually reinforce bad habits instead of building elite control.

Our goal with this system is to give you a language for puck control: a mechanical framework you can understand, feel, and adjust. When you combine awareness with deliberate repetition, you build mastery.

Inside this course, you’ll learn:

1) How elite NHL players integrate skating, handling, and deception.

2) What mechanical adjustments create real control at top speed.

3) How to systematically close the gaps in your own puck control.

4) How to create more options in more situations during games.

👉  Drills, breakdowns, progressions, and full mechanics playbook (100’s of videos) all available in Train 2.0+. Welcome to Precise Puck Control.

There’s a reason we call this puck control and not just stickhandling.

Stickhandling usually refers to isolated mechanics like moving the puck around cones or in drills disconnected and from real gameplay. Puck control, in our context, is different. It’s the conscious ability to move the puck exactly where you want, at the speed you want, while your skating, shooting, and deception mechanics are fully integrated.

At Train 2.0, we teach it as part of a complete movement system.

The truth: isolated stickhandling doesn’t transfer to games. You might develop quick hands. You might look smooth in drills. But without integrating footwork, balance, posture, and skating mechanics, you’ll be missing that puck on a string look in-game.

We’ve all seen players with “great hands” who somehow struggle in games. That disconnect happens when puck skills are trained without mechanical awareness or integration. Repeating the same patterns around cones without adjusting mechanics can actually reinforce bad habits instead of building elite control.

Our goal with this system is to give you a language for puck control: a mechanical framework you can understand, feel, and adjust. When you combine awareness with deliberate repetition, you build mastery.

Inside this course, you’ll learn:

1) How elite NHL players integrate skating, handling, and deception.

2) What mechanical adjustments create real control at top speed.

3) How to systematically close the gaps in your own puck control.

4) How to create more options in more situations during games.

👉  Drills, breakdowns, progressions, and full mechanics playbook (100’s of videos) all available in Train 2.0+.

För den Kinesiska marknaden har Volvo meddelat att man satsar på laddhybrider och information som jag fått säger att en av alla nya bilar för Kina blir en ny Volvo V70!
Kanske en EV70?!

Bilen ska bygga på Lynk & Co 07GT, som är en laddhybrid, som går ca 20 mil på el enligt den Kinesiska normen. Bilen är 4,8 meter lång.
Volvo har för övrigt tagit över ansvaret för försäljningen  av Lynk & Co i Europa, så de två varumärkena närmar sig varandra mer och mer.
Den XC70 som säljs i Kina, är också en laddhybrid, baserad på Lynk & Co 08.

Jag intervjuar min kinesiska Youtubekollega Jacky Wang, som har mycket bra blick över den Kinesiska marknaden, och han tycker att Volvo gör helt rätt som fokuserar på laddhybrider.

videos.summary_source_text:
How to Shallow Your Driver Without Forcing It If your driver swing gets steep or over the top, trying to manually “drop” the golf club usually isn’t the best fix. ⛳️

What you really need is a better reference for where the club should travel in the downswing.

COMMENT "BRICK ME" & I'll send over the link!

Watch the path of the driver in this drill.
Instead of the club working steeply over the top, the goal is to give it room to shallow in transition and approach the golf ball on a better swing plane.

Why does that matter?
A better driver swing path can make it easier to:
→ Stop cutting across the golf ball
→ Deliver the club more consistently
→ Create a more inside approach to impact
→ Build a repeatable driver swing without adding more swing thoughts

And this is an important distinction:
You’re not trying to place the golf club into a perfect position.
You’re training your body to recognize the space the club needs to move through.
That’s why using an external reference can be so helpful.
With the Blue Brick, the alignment stick gives you immediate feedback: instead of wondering whether your downswing is shallow enough, you have a physical constraint to work around.

The goal becomes simple:
Swing without crashing into the reference.

Do that repeatedly and you can start building the feel of a shallower driver swing rather than trying to memorize another technical position.

There is only about 1 teaspoon of sugar in your blood at any given time. That amount can rise to around 1.5 teaspoons with prediabetes and 2 teaspoons with diabetes. Medication can help manage high blood sugar, but it doesn’t address the root cause.

Exercise is one of the best ways to lower blood sugar naturally because your muscles can use the excess glucose for energy. Walking after dinner can be especially beneficial for lowering blood glucose levels.

The order in which you eat your food can also affect blood glucose levels and help prevent blood sugar spikes. Meal timing matters too, so avoid eating too close to bedtime.

Removing sugar from your diet is one of the best ways to control blood sugar. This can also help your body burn fat for fuel while reducing cravings and appetite.

videos.title: Just 2 cloves of garlic! And your orchid will bloom nonstop!
videos.summary_source_text:
Just 2 cloves of garlic! And your orchid will bloom nonstop! Just 2 cloves of garlic! And your orchid will bloom nonstop!

Two cloves of garlic and a glass of water — that's the whole recipe. Garlic water is one of the oldest tricks orchid growers use, and it does three jobs at once: it disinfects the roots, cleans and protects the leaves, and feeds the plant without any chemistry.

In this video I show the whole process from start to finish:

00:00  Why fresh garlic, and never dried or powdered
00:45  Chopping it fine so the compounds pass into the water
01:41  Making the infusion — water, lid, a few hours
02:25  Straining it through a sieve and cheesecloth
02:56  Wiping the leaves with a cotton pad, top and underside
03:53  Watering the substrate with what's left

The result is firm glossy leaves, living roots that don't rot, and an orchid that blooms far more willingly.

No fertilizers, no chemicals, no special equipment. Garlic, water, a cotton pad.

Bizarre Vitamin D Deficiency Symptoms You’ve Never Heard Of Vitamin D deficiency can show up in surprising ways. Beyond bone health, low vitamin D has been associated with a wide range of symptoms and health concerns.

Watch the FULL video here: ▶️https://youtu.be/X2T2Vd9utcs

🌟Take the 2-minute Health Lever Quiz: https://drbrg.co/4bAtijw

Just so you know, my full line of high-quality supplements is available on Amazon — search Dr. Berg Supplements. 

Signs and conditions associated with low vitamin D include:
• Nightmares
• Restless legs
• Acne
• Skipped heartbeats or palpitations
• Breathing concerns
• Skin concerns
• Sinus issues and hay fever
• Recurrent tonsil problems
• Fatigue
• Early puberty
• Irregular menstrual cycles
• Urinary incontinence
• Vertigo
• Age-related muscle loss
• Vision and eye health concerns
• Erectile dysfunction

Vitamin D supports healthy bones, muscles, immune function, and many other processes throughout the body. If you think your vitamin D levels may be low, consider speaking with your healthcare provider about testing.

videos.title: How to do the 360 in Hockey
videos.summary_source_text:
How to do the 360 in Hockey The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body’s own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness.
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: 2 Golf Swing Release Positions for More Distance
videos.summary_source_text:
2 Golf Swing Release Positions for More Distance Want more clubhead speed and distance without just trying to swing harder? Pay attention to these two positions in your golf swing. ⛳️

Position 1: Maintain the lag in your downswing.
When the club reaches roughly parallel to the ground, you don’t want the clubhead to have already thrown past your hands.
If you release that angle too early, you’re essentially spending your speed before you get to the golf ball.
Instead, work on moving pressure toward the target while maintaining that wrist angle and lag deeper into the downswing.

Position 2: Let the club release through impact.
Creating lag doesn’t mean holding the club back forever.
Once you reach the strike, the club needs to release and continue moving through the ball.

That’s the sequence:
Create the lag → maintain it longer → release it through impact.
The goal isn’t to freeze your golf swing into a position. It’s to train the sequence so the club can build and release speed at the right time.

And if you struggle to actually feel that lag position, that’s exactly what the SLR3 Bumblebee is designed to help you practice. 🐝

If you leave this video without trying the toe line drill, you're leaving a correct golf swing plane and consistent ball striking on the table.

Why getting the club on golf swing plane during delivery is the key to solid consistent ball striking

How Rory McIlroy, Justin Thomas, and Xander Schauffele get the club on plane from hip high to hip high
How to identify whether you have a steep downswing or shallow golf swing from your ball flight

Steep downswing fix: arms down thumbs down club down to stop coming over the top
Shallow golf swing fix: feeling high and outside to find neutral swing plane and eliminate pushes and hooks
How to use the golf downswing sequence drills with Swing Coach app feedback to get on plane faster

If you’ve tried golf swing tips to hit your driver straighter, improve your iron strike or stop coming over the top, but the changes never seem to last, this golf lesson is for you.

After working with some of the best players in the game, I noticed they do something very differently that helps them improve their golf swing faster, make changes that stick and take those improvements onto the golf course with far fewer swing thoughts.

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-2208

We’ve got our hands on the Gunther Werks F26, and we’re putting it up against some incredible supercars! 

The Gunther Werks F26 is based on a Porsche 993, and it’s powered by a 4-litre twin-turbo flat-six that delivers an incredible 1,067hp and 1,017Nm! This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual, and its carbon-fibre body means it weighs just 1,347kg! It’s limited to just 26 units worldwide, so it costs £1,200,000! 

So, given we’ve got our hands on such a rare car, we wanted to put it up against some supercar royalty, starting with the Porsche 911 GT3 RS. 

The GT3 RS is equipped with a 4-litre NA flat-six, and this creates 525hp and 465Nm. Power is sent to the rear via a 7-speed dual-clutch, and it tips the scales at 1,450kg. 

Should the Gunther Werks defeat the GT3 RS, we’ll bring in a Huracán Performante. This comes with a 5.2-litre naturally aspirated V10, and it puts down 640hp and 600Nm. However, unlike the F26, it comes with all-wheel drive! It’s still heavier, mind, coming in at 1,482kg. 

Should the F26 beat the Huracan, we have another contender waiting in the wings… But you’ll need to keep watching to see what it is! 

The question is, do you think the Gunther Werks F26 is worth the £1.2m price tag? Let us know in the comments!

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

videos.title: How to Shallow the Golf Club Like the Pros
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Shallow the Golf Club Like the Pros How to Shallow the Golf Club Like the Pros

Trying to shallow the golf club in your downswing? Don’t make the mistake of trying to force the club shallow with your hands. 👀⛳️

A better place to start is your backswing position.
If your hands and arms don’t have enough room at the top, it becomes much harder for the club to reroute and work from the inside during the downswing.

Instead, look at:
→ Getting enough rotation in the backswing
→ Allowing your hands to work deeper
→ Creating space with your arm and elbow position
→ Giving the club room to shallow naturally in transition

The goal isn’t to manufacture a shallow golf swing.
It’s to build a backswing and golf swing sequence that gives the club somewhere to go.
More room going back = a much better opportunity to approach the golf ball from the inside coming down.

And remember: getting the club shallow is only useful if you can turn that delivery into better contact.

Working on shallowing your golf swing? Now make sure the move actually produces better contact.
