videos.summary_source_text:
OpenAI and Google Just Changed Cybersecurity Forever https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
OpenAI and Google just made two very different bets on the future of AI cybersecurity.

OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Cyber goes deep: a highly capable cybersecurity model designed to find, understand, and help exploit software vulnerabilities — but access is tightly restricted.

Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber goes wide: a smaller, faster model built to scan huge amounts of code repeatedly through Google's CodeMender system.

Both approaches have already found real security vulnerabilities. But there's a catch: the numbers being used to compare them aren't actually comparable, and neither company has proven its model is definitively better.

In this video, we break down:

• GPT-5.6-Cyber and OpenAI's Daybreak program
• Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber and Google CodeMender
• The real vulnerabilities these AI systems have discovered
• Why these cybersecurity models remain heavily restricted
• Why OpenAI and Google's benchmark numbers can't be directly compared
• The growing AI cybersecurity race involving Anthropic, Microsoft, DARPA and others
• What AI-powered vulnerability research means for cybersecurity

The bigger question isn't simply whether OpenAI or Google wins. It's whether the future of AI cybersecurity belongs to extremely powerful models operating under tight controls — or smaller models scanning software continuously at massive scale.

videos.summary_source_text:
Challe möter Patrik Zackrisson: "Det är jävligt surt” I en intervjuserie tar Challe Berglund och Jonas Junland pulsen på några spelare inför säsongen. 

Först ut är Challes möte med Patrik Zackrisson, som ger sin syn på:

Vad som grämer honom mest under sin långa karriär: ”Jävligt surt”

Drömmen med Leksand nu: ”Skiter i om jag spelar eller inte"

Det har hans karriär betytt för honom – och för familjen: ”Våga prova saker”

Det talar för Leksand 26/27

videos.summary_source_text:
GPT-5.6 Is 14× Faster… But There’s a BIG Problem https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
OpenAI's GPT-5.6 is here — with up to 750 tokens per second, an 88.8% agentic coding score, a 1 MILLION-token context window, and new AI agents designed to do real work for you.

But is GPT-5.6 actually the smartest AI model yet — or is the biggest story hiding somewhere else?

In this video, I break down GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna, ChatGPT Work, Codex, OpenAI's new agent capabilities, benchmark results, pricing, and the new Ultrafast mode. We also compare GPT-5.6 against Claude, Gemini and Grok to see where OpenAI is really ahead — and where the competition still wins.

Some of the numbers are huge:

• Up to 750 output tokens/second
• Roughly 14× faster in Ultrafast mode
• 88.8% on Terminal-Bench 2.1
• 52.7 on Agents' Last Exam
• 1 MILLION tokens of context
• Around 1/3 the cost per task of Claude in one independent analysis
• Yet only around 7.8% on ARC-AGI

And there's a bigger question: can ChatGPT Work actually operate like an autonomous AI coworker, or do these agents still need a human checking everything they produce?

We dig into the benchmarks, the speed claims, hallucinations, autonomous AI agents, Codex, and what GPT-5.6 means for the AI race between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI.

videos.title: How to Compress Your Irons: Right Elbow + Pressure Shift
videos.summary_source_text:
How to Compress Your Irons: Right Elbow + Pressure Shift Want to compress your irons and create better ball-first contact? Your right elbow at impact might be telling you what’s going wrong. 👀⛳️

A lot of golfers try to force the right elbow down in the downswing—but if your pressure and body aren’t moving correctly first, there may not be enough room for the elbow to get into a strong impact position.

Instead, pay attention to the sequence:
→ Shift pressure toward the target
→ Give the right elbow room to work in front of the body
→ Keep the upper body from taking over too early
→ Arrive at impact in a better position to compress the golf ball

That pressure shift is a huge piece of creating a more consistent golf swing, low point, iron strike, and ball-first contact.

You don’t need to manufacture the perfect impact position with your arms. Train the movement that helps your body arrive there naturally.

And that’s exactly where the Ball First Board comes in. 👇

If you struggle with hanging back, inconsistent contact, or getting into the right position at impact, use the Ball First Board to train the pressure shift this video is teaching.
It gives you a physical way to practice moving pressure forward so you can build a more repeatable pattern for ball-first contact and compressed iron shots.

videos.summary_source_text:
Ska du köpa simulator? Missa inte detta… Det är snart dags att tänka på vintergolf i simulator. Missa inte detta om du funderar på att köpa en ny simulator i år. Här kommer en presentation av GolfJoy som jag nu använt i ett år och är supernöjd med.

www.easygreen.se      www.golfstudiosweden.se.    www.rydbo360.se

#golf #golftips #golfswing 

0:00 Intro till att köpa ny simulator

Nu finns det möjlighet att genom appen Skillest göra mig till din personliga tränare. Du hittar mig på denna länk: https://skillest.com/app/profile/marcus-edblad

Låt mig hjälpa dig finna bättre slag, bollträff, riktning och svinghastighet. Oavsett om du slår en wedge, järnklubba eller driver kan du med dina händer lära dig golfslag som du inte trodde var möjliga. Längre och rakare slag kräver alltid träning men något alla kan lära sig.  

Vare sig du kämpar med en slice eller en hook så har jag videos som kan guida till bättre golf. Är du nybörjare så kan du börja med min grönt kort eller nybörjarkurs.

Försök ersätta dåliga vanor med nya bättre vanor. Oavsett vilket loft eller skaft din klubba har så är det du som bestämmer vad som ska hända. Oavsett om det står callaway, ping, titleist eller taylor made på klubban så kan du slå bra slag.

Var noga med vad du tittar på. Det finns många duktiga instruktörer på nätet, några av mina favoriter är Mike Malaska, Mike Dunaway, Mike Austin.

Försök fokusera på grunderna i slaget bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår. Träna med fördel på en sak i taget. Tränar du din svinghastighet måste du tillåta att det går snett och tränar du raka slag kan du inte samtidigt svinga i max fart.

Ha tålamod och låt det ta sin tid, luras inte av genvägar som bara gör att du tappar fokus från det viktiga. Golf kommer alltid vara svårt men vi kan med träning se till att vi blir bättre för varje dag som går.

Titta mycket på golf på TV. Bryson Dechambeu, Dustin Johnson, Rory Mcilroy kan inspirera till längre slag och andra som Tiger Woods, Viktor Hovland, Ludvig Åberg och Phil Mickelson kan ge dig fantasi att skapa nya slag.

Träna styrketräning för hela kroppen för att må bra genom livet och skapa en effektiv maskin. Träna händer, handleder och armar för att skapa en effektiv release och mer svinghastighet.

Du kan finna inspiration i filmer som Happy Gilmore, Tin Cup eller Bagger Vance. Filmer som Rocky kan ge dig motivation att ta dig till gymet. Legender som Arnold Schwarzenegger, Sylvester Stallone eller Hulk Hogan kan få dig att vilja bli starkare och Moe Norman, Arnold Palmer, Ben Hogan, Sam Snead eller Jack Nicklaus kan inspirera dig att bli en bättre golfare. 

Ge aldrig upp i sökandet och träningen för att få bästa bollträff, bladkontroll och svingspår.

😋 Better than Chocolate Eggs - Ice Cream in a Minute WITHOUT Sugar. Never Buy Them in the Store 😋 Better than Chocolate Eggs - Ice Cream in a Minute WITHOUT Sugar. Never buy them at the store - make them at home with healthy ingredients.

4.2 oz (120 g) sugar-free dark chocolate.
Melt the chocolate using any method you like.
Today we’re making a delicious and healthier homemade dessert.
We’ll use a Chocolate Egg container as our mold.
We’re throwing away all the sweet cream because it’s loaded with refined sugar.
1 cup (150 g) cashews. Soak in boiling water for 30 minutes. 1 cup (250 ml) milk of your choice. I used almond milk.
5 Medjool dates. Vanilla.
¼ cup (50 g) peanut butter.
Coat the inside of the mold with the first layer of chocolate and place in the freezer for 10 minutes.
This dessert is incredibly easy to make with just a few simple ingredients.
Coat the inside of the mold with the second layer of chocolate and place in the freezer for 10 minutes.
But then I ran into a little problem! 😅
The chocolate wouldn’t come out of the mold.
So these Chocolate Eggs aren’t just loaded with sugar—the containers aren’t very useful as molds either!
I won’t be buying them again.
From now on, I’ll use a silicone mold instead.
Coat the silicone mold with a layer of chocolate and place in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Place in the freezer for 2–3 hrs.

20.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.title: How Should You Skate In A Tight Circle
videos.summary_source_text:
How Should You Skate In A Tight Circle The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: Elon Musk’s “Macrohard” Could Change Work Forever… If It Actually Works
videos.summary_source_text:
Elon Musk’s “Macrohard” Could Change Work Forever… If It Actually Works https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Elon Musk’s Macrohard sounds almost impossible: an AI system designed to emulate the functions of an entire software company — potentially handling coding, customer support, spreadsheets, enterprise software and more through autonomous AI agents.

But how much of it is actually real?

In this video, I break down Elon Musk’s Macrohard AI project, the reported Tesla and xAI connection, the technology behind its computer-use agents, the money involved, and the surprisingly large gap between what has been promised and what has actually been demonstrated.

The idea is ambitious. Grok would act as the “brain,” planning complex tasks, while a Tesla-built computer-use agent would act as the “body” — watching a computer screen and operating software through the mouse and keyboard.

And unlike many AI agents that depend on integrations or APIs, the bigger vision is an AI worker capable of using software much more like a human does.

If it works, the implications could extend far beyond Tesla, xAI or Microsoft. It could affect enterprise software, SaaS pricing, customer support, software development and ultimately the way companies think about human work itself.

But there’s a major problem.

There still hasn’t been a public demonstration proving the full vision works — and reporting around the project raises questions about how quickly Musk’s ambitious plan can actually become reality.

So is Macrohard the beginning of the AI-run company?

Or is the hype moving much faster than the technology?

Watch the full breakdown before deciding.
